title: Spec 014 Tenant Canary Canonical Structured Evidence

phases.objective: Publish one exact-head, secret-free canonical JSON/Markdown Tenant Canary artifact while retaining all synthetic, provenance, not-before, ordering, and regression coverage under the canonical GitHub Actions workflow path.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 reviewer and repository evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The fixed-command Tenant Canary canonical runner and the canonical-path Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact PR head executes all eight guard checks, writes a run-bound canonical report with bounded diagnostics, and returns an enforceable pass/fail decision without reconstructing status from Job logs.
steps: Validate the producer/report contract and workflow safety boundary.
Execute the canonical Tenant Canary runner directly under E2E governance on the exact PR head.
Run deterministic dependency installation, syntax, synthetic boundary, Base import, runtime provenance, policy not-before, pre-consumption ordering, and the complete Tenant Canary regression suite.
Redact and bound stdout/stderr tails before storing structured results.
Write mad4b.hostinger-guard-summary.v1 JSON and Markdown before returning the guard result.
Upload both files with if:always under a run-bound Artifact name when the canonical-path workflow is scheduled.
Validate exact SHA, counts, results, first failure, integrity findings, no-secret declaration, no-log decision, and no-mutation/provider/credential declarations before enforcing the outcome.
assertions: The workflow remains named Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and is stored at the canonical workflow path.
The report workflow and guard_key identify Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals the exact pull-request head.
All eight fixed checks execute successfully under the current E2E journey.
A passed report has eight passes, zero failures, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
A failed report identifies the first failed check and includes only bounded redacted diagnostics.
The workflow retains contents:read and receives no issue, pull-request, action, or repository write authority.
The workflow has no workflow_dispatch, git push, force push, provider call, Hostinger/SSH access, credential access, SQL, migration, deployment, or Production mutation.
repository_mutation_performed, provider_dispatch_performed, credential_access_performed, job_logs_consulted, and secrets_included remain false.
Trusted PR-comment publication requires the run-bound canonical Artifact to be consumed by the main-based CI Evidence PR Publisher for the same exact head.

phases.objective: Exact-head publication is proven on PR #4660 at SHA ec230596a071f1dad7857284d43b9d903f9204a5 and again at SHA 4481b37543ca3ff7c6c24b535fed9eebccadab56: Tenant Canary produced mad4b.hostinger-guard-summary.v1 with 8/8 passed and zero findings; E2E triggered the trusted fallback; the shared authoritative comment published both sections with the same SHA, Job logs diagnostic-only, and no secret, provider, credential, repository, SQL, migration, deployment, or Production action.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The operational contract remains executable: the producer schema is valid, all eight Tenant Canary checks pass on the candidate head, and the recorded trusted publication evidence binds E2E and Tenant sections to one exact SHA.
steps: Revalidate the canonical report producer and workflow safety contract.
Execute the fixed Tenant Canary eight-check runner on the exact candidate head.
Require eight passes, zero failures, zero integrity findings, first_failure=null, secrets_included=false, and job_logs_consulted=false.
Retain the recorded authoritative-comment evidence for runs 30729924136/30729924130 and 30730011066/30730011073 on their matching exact heads.
assertions: The operational proof is supported by two independent exact-head publication cycles.
The current executable runner still selects exactly eight checks and all eight pass.
The producer and runner perform no provider dispatch, credential access, repository mutation, SQL, migration, deployment, or Production action.
The authoritative comment remains derived from canonical Artifacts and Job logs remain diagnostic-only.
